DRDO develops 'Kavach' system to counter enemy espionage

The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has developed a system named 'Kavach' designed to prevent enemy espionage and secure sensitive data. This development is presented as a significant achievement aimed at blocking enemy intelligence gathering efforts and making the theft of secret data impossible.
